This category is a listing of templates found (and hopefully used) on the [[{{Name|bi}}]] wiki.

Please choose a sensible and descriptive name when creating a template so that others may easily find this template and reuse it.<br>
Take caution when updating a template that has been used frequently in the wiki. One small change could affect many pages that rely on this template.
|
{{Feature|important|
Use the following code to categorise the template:
<syntaxhighlight lang="html">
<noinclude>[[Category:Templates|{{uc:{{PAGENAME}}}}]]</noinclude>
</syntaxhighlight>
Make sure to keep the <noinclude> tags, otherwise it will categorise every page in which the template is used in the [[:Category:Templates|Templates]] category!<br>
See [[Template:Doc/Template|Doc/Template]] for a template's documentation model that manages the category automatically.
}}
|}
